balance:
# All gameplay tunables (D-005). Shared by every target.
# Values are converted once to fixed-point at load time and hashed after conversion (D-011).
# Global rules only; per-species stats live in species.toml (D-029). Values are placeholders.

[sim]
tick_hz = 10             # §4 fixed tick
flora_every_ticks = 8    # §5.3: flora fields at 1.25 Hz (D-038; keep growth x dt <= 1)
pace = 0.75              # seconds of ecology per real second (D-069): growth, spread, income,
                         # feeding and breeding run at this pace; movement and the clock do not
env_every_ticks = 10     # §5.3: nutrients / water at 1 Hz
grid_size = 32           # §5.1: 1 cell = 4 m, a 128 m map (D-047, D-049, D-070, D-091)
chunk_size = 32          # §5.3 chunk sleeping, hashing

[match]
players = 2
victory_territory = 0.80 # §2.3, Q-013, D-094, D-147
time_limit_s = 36000     # §2.3: 600 min, virtually no limit (D-138; was 60 min, D-094)
territory_decay = true   # gamerules §11.3, D-143: the threshold decays linearly ...
territory_start = 0.80   # ... from this (held until decay_from_s) ...
territory_end = 0.60     # ... to this at decay_to_s, so a lead ends the match (about 30 min)
decay_from_s = 1200      # real seconds: the decay starts at 20 min ...
decay_to_s = 2400        # ... and ends at 40 min

# Bot difficulty (D-143): the bots' income factor by level (easy, normal, hard); humans earn 1.
# With play quality (easy plays at home, hard adds drops and catastrophes) it makes the ladder.
[bots]
income = [0.8, 1.0, 1.25]

[agents]
max_agents = 2000        # §5.4 budget; per player: half

[net]
input_delay_ticks = 2    # §10: 200 ms at 10 Hz
stall_timeout_s = 10     # §10
hash_every_ticks = 10    # §10: desync check once per second

# Terrain (gamerules §2.3). V1: flat, loam, constant water and light. Species may add optional
# water_optimum / water_tolerance, light_optimum / light_tolerance (0..1; tolerance 0 = indifferent)
# and soil_affinity = { sandy = 1.2, ... }; absent keys are neutral (D-024).
[terrain]
water = 0.5              # moisture of a flat map (and the land species' water optimum)
light = 1.0
soil_types = ["loam", "sandy", "clay_limestone"]
# Map generator (D-083, D-096): relief with valleys and cliffs; one water layout per seed (a
# river crossing the map, a central lake fed by streams, scattered ponds, or dry highlands),
# rivers following the low ground; rock bands on cliffs and outcrops; moisture. Every map has
# 180-degree symmetry (fair 1v1).
generate = true          # false: the flat V1 map (tests, prototype parity)
noise_cells = [12, 6, 3] # value-noise lattice spacing per octave (cells)
noise_weights = [0.6, 0.3, 0.1]
valley_cells = 8         # winding valleys: lattice spacing of the fold noise (cells) ...
valley_width = 0.12      # ... and half width (share of the noise range); depth: per map type
cliff_steepness = 2.0    # plateaus are joined by steps this much steeper than the slope
cliff_drop = 0.14        # a drop to a neighbour of this share of the relief makes a cliff (rock) ...
cliff_gaps = 0.5         # ... except where the rock noise is below this (passes)
river_width = 2.0        # cells (streams feeding a lake: 1)
deep_share = 0.15        # chance that a river cell is a deep (uncrossable) pool
pond_radius = 3          # cells; ponds of radius >= 2 have a deep centre
lake_radius = 3          # cells; the central lake (radius 2 or 3)
home_clear = 4           # cells around each home kept dry, rock-free and flatter
water_level = 0.1        # height of every water bed, as a share of the map's relief
bank_rise = 0.1          # banks rise this share of the map's relief per cell away from water
moisture_dry = 0.3       # land moisture on the highest ground ...
moisture_wet = 0.75      # ... and in the lowest land / next to water (water cells: 1)
bank_cells = 4           # water raises land moisture over this many cells
relief_m = 16.0          # render only: metres of relief of a map type with relief = 1

# Map types (D-102): each seed draws one, by weight. relief: share of the full relief; terraces:
# plateaus (0: none); valley_depth: share of the relief; cliffs: rock bands on steep steps;
# rock_share: outcrops on the high ground; water: none, river (crossing the map), lake (central,
# fed by two streams) or flood (the lowest `flood` share of the map under water, `flood_deep` of
# it deep); ponds: pairs of ponds in the basins, on top.

# Flora cell model (gamerules §2.1, §3; D-019). Species stats are in species.toml.
# Rates are per second; fractions are of the species' k_max. Biomass is in u16 units (0..65535).
[flora]
seed_fraction = 0.1        # seed rain: biomass added per unit of gauge gained, as a fraction of k_max
establish_threshold = 0.1  # a stratum counts for the dominant level from this fraction
smother_rate = 0.15        # enemy strata lose this fraction of k_max per second, per attacking neighbour
litter_fraction = 0.1      # litter per second = this x biomass_rate x biomass (turnover)
niche_overlap = 0.5        # [Proposed] competition between species of one stratum (1 = full overlap, D-022)
soil_min_level = [0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.6]  # soil development for full suitability, per height stratum: herbs (non-pioneers), intermediate, shrubs, trees
soil_ramp = 0.1           # suitability ramps from 0 at soil_min - soil_ramp to 1 at soil_min (D-024)
plant_gauge = 0.5         # colonization gauge of a freshly planted species (D-024)
plant_radius = 2          # a plant order seeds a disc of this radius, in cells (gamerules §7.1; D-042)
# [Proposed] rules behind switches (D-019)
succession = true
shade = true
contested_cells = true

# Fauna agents (gamerules §5.2, §6; D-023, D-026). Species stats are in species.toml.
[deadwood]
natural_death_s = 10800 # mean life of a tree stand (ecology seconds, 3 h): trees die of old age, standing (D-127)
wood_share = 0.3        # share of a dead stand that stays standing as dead wood; the rest falls as litter
rot_s = 600             # time for standing dead wood to rot away without recyclers (ecology seconds)

# Catastrophe cards (D-129): late-game trump cards, available from the start, paid at each use,
# then cooling down (real seconds) before the same player may play them again. They hit
# everything in their disc, both players alike. act: kill_trees (trees die standing, D-127),
# storm (shrubs and trees felled to litter), spill (back to bare soil); chance: per cell per
# flora tick while it acts.
[catastrophes.processionary_caterpillars]
act = "kill_trees"
cost = 15000
radius = 4
cooldown_s = 300
duration_s = 8
chance = 0.35
effect = "Processionary caterpillars strip the woods: the trees in the area die standing within seconds."

[catastrophes.storm]
act = "storm"
cost = 22000
radius = 9
cooldown_s = 420
duration_s = 6
chance = 0.06
effect = "A violent storm sweeps a wide area: here and there, shrubs and trees are felled."

[catastrophes.chemical_spill]
act = "spill"
cost = 10000
radius = 1
cooldown_s = 240
duration_s = 0
chance = 1.0
effect = "A chemical spill poisons a few cells: back to bare soil, owned by no one."

# Weather (D-132): random events, one or two per half hour, each announced by a weather alert.
# Times are real seconds. Factors apply while it lasts: growth on positive plant growth, speed
# on animal movement, bite on herbivore bites. Drought kills a share of the tree stands (dead
# trees, D-127) and lays a share of the grass-only cells bare over the event; a flood turns
# land cells next to water into shallows (chance per cell) until it ends, drowning the plants
# whose moisture response under full water is below drown_below.
[weather]
first_s = [480, 900]    # the first event starts in this window
gap_s = [720, 1200]     # from the end of one event to the start of the next
warning_s = 30          # the weather alert comes this long before

[[weather.kinds]]
name = "rain"
weight = 1
duration_s = 150
growth = 1.15
speed = 0.9
bite = 1.0
effect = "Steady rain: plants grow a little faster, animals move a little slower."

[[weather.kinds]]
name = "drought"
weight = 1
duration_s = 150
growth = 0.4
speed = 0.9
bite = 0.85
tree_death = 0.12
grass_loss = 0.2
effect = "Drought: plants grow much slower, animals are sluggish; some trees die standing and some grass patches dry up to bare soil."

[[weather.kinds]]
name = "flood"
weight = 1
duration_s = 120
growth = 0.85
speed = 0.85
bite = 1.0
flood = 0.6
drown_below = 0.5
effect = "Flood: the water rises over its banks for a while, drowning the land plants there; plants grow a little slower, animals move slower."

[fauna]
transfer = 0.1          # share of eaten biomass that becomes the eater's energy (10 % rule)
diet_yield = [1.0, 0.75, 0.5]  # energy from a primary, secondary, tertiary food, as a share of the transfer (D-123)
own_graze = 0.2         # bite on own flora, relative to enemy flora (gamerules §10)
soil_per_dead = 0.5     # soil development (u16 units) per unit of dead biomass decomposed
lockout_s = 30          # a cell grazed bare turns neutral; its former owner may not retake it for this long (D-098)
herbivore_range = 10    # prototype only (tools/prototype): sim-core drops herbivores near the click
drop_radius = 4         # a drop (herbivores off own land, predators) lands within this many cells of the click (D-061)
flee_radius = 3         # prey flee enemy hunters closer than this
refuge_flora = ["hawthorn", "bramble", "cattails"]  # cattails: refuge in the water (D-125)
refuge_cover = 0.5      # summed cover of refuge flora that hides small fauna (D-023)
# Terrain (D-084): walkers cross shallows at this share of their speed; a path search explores at
# most this many cells before giving up (then the animal stays).
shallow_speed = 0.5
path_cells = 400
# Local carrying capacity (D-066): a birth needs food nearby, within the species' sight.
food_reserve = 300      # grazers, decomposers: seconds of bites the food in sight must hold per animal
prey_per_predator = 4   # predators: huntable enemy prey in sight per predator
strike_radius = 1       # a predator catches prey up to this many cells away (each axis), once per flora tick
catch_chance = 0.5      # chance that a hunting predator with prey in reach makes its kill, per flora tick
# Organic movement (D-065): steering at any angle, plus a Brownian drift and scattered targets.
wobble = 0.35           # random kick to an animal's drift each tick, as a share of its speed
wobble_keep = 0.8       # share of the drift kept from one tick to the next (0 = white noise)
scatter = 0.4           # food and order targets: random offset from the cell centre (cells, < 0.5)
wander_radius = 1.5     # an idle animal strolls to a random point this far away at most (cells), ahead of where it goes
steer = 0.15            # fluid motion (D-111): share of the gap to the wanted velocity closed per tick (turns and starts take about 0.6 s)

# Economy (gamerules §4, §7; D-027, D-029). Costs and yields are per species (species.toml).
[economy]
start_budget = 1000
drop_surcharge = 1.5         # any animal landing outside own land costs more (§6.3; D-061)
species:
# species.toml — per-species stats (D-029, D-087). Tune freely; values are placeholders for M7.
# Loaded together with balance.toml (both are converted and hashed together, D-011).
#
# Stats (first block of each species):
#   growth       plants: colonization gauge speed at full pressure (1/s)
#                animals: minimum seconds between two births of a well-fed animal
#   spawn_cost   plants: points per cell planted; animals: points per animal
#   unlock_cost  points to unlock the species card (0 = available at start)
#   yield        points per second: per fully covered cell (plants), per animal (animals)
#   cap          plants: share of the map's cells per player (0..1, D-045); animals: max animals per player
#   effect       special effect, shown in the UI
#
# Tech tree (D-087): family = the build-bar group, tier = small (1), medium (2), large (3). A card
#   needs a card of the previous tier of its family. Plant families: L1 herbaceous, L2 intermediate,
#   L3 shrubs, L4 trees, W aquatic. Animal families: D detritivores, H1..H4 eaters of L1..L4,
#   HW aquatic grazers, P1 insect eaters, P2 small-mammal eaters, P3 large-mammal eaters,
#   PW aquatic hunters. Habitat entries are species or family names (L1..L4, W). Diets (`eats`)
#   are species in rank order, primary first, at most three (D-122); recyclers eat "dead".
#   Within a layer, tier n animals eat the tier n plant first (D-126); tier-1 insects live a layer
#   below their food.
#
# Model (second block):
#   Plants: level = height stratum 1..4 (shade and competition act between strata);
#   water_optimum / water_tolerance = moisture response (0..1; land plants 0.5 / 0.6: neutral on a
#   flat map, slow in the shallows, D-084; aquatic plants want the water); biomass_rate = logistic
#   r (1/s); k_max = biomass capacity of a cell (u16); shade_cast / shade_tolerance 0..1;
#   soil_gain = soil development per second at full cover.
#   Animals: role, eats, habitat, small = can hide in a refuge, swarm = drawn as a swarm, not a
#   unit (D-065), body (energy capacity), bite (1/s), upkeep (share of body per s), speed and
#   sight (cells), group (animals per spawned card), medium = walk, swim, amphibious or fly (D-084).
#   Movement (D-088): wobble / wobble_keep = drift kick (share of speed) and drift kept per tick,
#   defaulting to [fauna]; rest = chance to stay put at an idle decision (stop-and-go).
